parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV with a Company number column. Legal company name is optional; the backend will look it up.

parameters.jsCode:
const result = $json; const rows = result.results || []; const created = rows.filter(x => x.status === 'created' || x.status === 'refreshed').length; const failed = rows.filter(x => x.status === 'failed').length; return { json: { ...result, subject: `Bulk upload complete — ${created} processed, ${failed} failed`, html: `

Bulk company upload complete

Processed: ${created}
Failed: ${failed}

${JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2)}

Companies without additional due-diligence information remain visible in the dashboard as not provided.

` } };
